packages.name: Onam Sadhya
packages.blurb: The full leaf: 20 dishes served on banana leaf in the traditional order, ending with two payasams.

packages.name: Pooja Satvik Lunch
packages.blurb: No onion, no garlic. Vadai, sambar, rasam, kootu and sakkarai pongal, fit for naivedyam.

packages.name: Griha Pravesh Lunch
packages.blurb: Udupi temple-style meal for the housewarming: kosambari, gojju, saaru and holige.

packages.name: Ganesh Chaturthi Naivedya
packages.blurb: Ukadiche modak, puran poli and varan bhaat, the way Ganeshotsav is served at home.

packages.name: Eid Dawat
packages.blurb: Mutton dum biryani, mirchi ka salan, shikampuri kebabs and sheer khurma.

packages.name: Rajasthani Festive Thali
packages.blurb: Dal baati churma, gatte, ker sangri and bajra roti, cooked in real ghee.

packages.name: Diwali Family Feast
packages.blurb: Paneer tikka, dal makhani, chole and lachha paratha, with gulab jamun and kheer.

packages.name: Chettinad Sunday Feast
packages.blurb: Pepper chicken, mutton kuzhambu and Chettinad biryani, with paal paniyaram to finish.

packages.name: Gujarati Thali & Farsan
packages.blurb: Dhokla and khandvi to start, undhiyu and kadhi at the centre, shrikhand to end.

traditions.name: Kerala
traditions.blurb: Sadhya on banana leaf, coconut-rich curries and Syrian Christian and Malabar specialities.

traditions.name: Chettinad
traditions.blurb: Bold, freshly ground spice blends from Karaikudi, and some of Tamil Nadu's best vegetarian gravies.

traditions.name: Tamil Traditional
traditions.blurb: Festival and temple-style vegetarian cooking: the full elai saapadu with vadai and payasam.

traditions.name: Udupi & Mangalorean
traditions.signature: Saaru · Gojju · Neer dosa · Ghee roast
traditions.blurb: Temple-town vegetarian cooking from Udupi, plus Mangalore's coconut curries and ghee roasts.

traditions.name: Andhra & Telangana
traditions.blurb: Fiery pickles, tangy pulusus and the festive Ugadi and Sankranti spreads.

traditions.name: Hyderabadi
traditions.signature: Dum biryani · Mirchi ka salan · Double ka meetha
traditions.blurb: Deccani dawat cooking: slow dum biryani, rich salans and Eid sweets.

traditions.name: Bengali
traditions.blurb: Puja bhog, mustard-laced fish and the patient art of Bengali sweets.

traditions.name: Gujarati
traditions.blurb: The sweet-sour-spicy balance, farsan platters and the full Kathiyawadi thali.

traditions.name: Rajasthani & Marwari
traditions.signature: Dal baati churma · Gatte · Ker sangri
traditions.blurb: Desert-kitchen cooking built on ghee, gram flour and sun-dried beans, made for big family feasts.

traditions.name: Maharashtrian
traditions.blurb: Ganeshotsav naivedya, Konkan coconut curries and Kolhapuri heat.

traditions.name: Punjabi
traditions.signature: Sarson da saag · Dal makhani · Chole
traditions.blurb: Generous, ghee-rich home cooking, from Lohri saag to Diwali dinners.

traditions.name: Kashmiri
traditions.blurb: Wazwan courses and Kashmiri Pandit kitchens: fennel, dry ginger and slow-cooked yoghurt gravies.
